title: Briefing for 2026-10-25
intro: Good morning. Here is your briefing for 2026-10-25: US markets, global news, and the Philippines, in five minutes.
us: Trump's approval rating on economy hits all-time low as midterm looms: CNBC survey. UK inflation jumps to 3.5% — cementing rate hike expectations. Housing is flashing warning signs just as the Fed weighs more interest rate hikes. India’s finance minister says market liquidity makes it easier for investors to exit. U.S. budget deficit swells to almost $2 trillion for fiscal 2026, up 12% in a single year.
global: Almost 1,000 arrested as clashes follow another day of mass protests across France. Palestinian families displaced as Israeli forces demolish Hebron homes. Man arrested after fire at Hitler's mountaintop Eagle's Nest retreat. Father who killed Oregon school gunman describes anguish over children he couldn't save. British woman dies after trying to rescue sons swept away at sea in the Bahamas. Vanessa Trump says she is cancer-free six months after revealing diagnosis.
philippines: Where are the Philippines’ regular cultural shows?. Carlos Yulo misses out on World Championship floor exercise medal. Typhoon Rosal exits PAR; ITCZ bringing scattered rain. Philip Lustre Jr. arrest a ‘sad day for journalism in the Philippines’ – lawyer.
outro: That's your briefing. Have a great day.
